task: Core 1186 U11A read-only staging Office RLS and migration dependency preflight

assuranceCeiling.rationale: The staging Office RLS/entitlement schema is materially older than the repository, while its canonical plan sync and grants are already in the later Block 11 model. Any direct replay of the five missing historical Office migrations would overwrite the live plan-sync authority. This bounded release improves only the read-only catalog snapshot/checker and negative tests, before a separately authorized schema migration. No runtime/tenant/database mutations.

acceptanceCriteria: Read-only Office catalog snapshot includes missing/privacy-sensitive schema prerequisites, private current-user read helper, tenant plan-grant authority and tenant-sync function presence without reading tenant identities, emails or data rows.
Readiness BLOCKs old broad authenticated ALL policies and missing Pro subscription predicates, participant table, privacy conversation column, current-user helper, and required migration lineage.
Readiness flags the existing Block 11 plan_capability_grants/sync authority and requires compatibility with it, rather than prescribing replay of an obsolete fixed-feature plan-sync function.

Staging observed legacy state stays BLOCK, full modeled security candidate remains REVIEW / METADATA_CANDIDATE_ONLY; never treat a clean catalog as proof of authenticated-user, plan transition, or service-role behavior.
Tests cover every new prerequisite, stale or partial catalog, and existing negative security outcomes, with exact-SHA Guard, Replay, CI, Truth and Lifecycle proof.
invariants: No SQL DDL or DML, Supabase migration application, plan-grant edits, browser role, tenant, credentials, environment setting or production deployment in U11A.
Never infer migration application from repository filenames; staging identity and actual source/target ancestry must be separately proven before U11B.
Do not replace Block 11 capability-grant entitlement authority with historical fixed arrays; Alap ordinary email and support must remain intact.
RLS metadata alone cannot verify a policy's effective authenticated role behavior, default privileges or service-role RPC isolation.
No #1186 or Market Ready DONE claim from metadata, even if report reaches REVIEW.
forbiddenStates: Historical migration files are blindly replayed over the staging schema or the current Block 11 sync function.
Readiness emits DONE or claims tenant isolation proved solely because an RLS expression contains expected text.
A missing helper, table, protection column or legacy ALL policy is ignored as a soft warning.
A development-stage or stale catalog artifact is used as authoritative evidence for a different environment.

failureModes: The missing Office privacy foundation depends on absent participant tables and altered thread schema; an isolated policy deployment would deny all support workflows.
The obsolete fixed-feature plan-sync migration overwrites a current normalized capability-grant authority and causes Alap/Pro entitlement drift.
The readiness script sees historical version numbers but misses runtime schema changes performed by later deployment timestamps.
An old ALL authenticated policy remains permissive and bypasses the intended participant and Pro checks.
A public SECURITY DEFINER read helper leaks cross-tenant visibility or permits arbitrary actor probes.
A schema-only green report overclaims runtime authenticated role and plan downgrade/expiry behavior.
edgeCases: Staging has 113 applied migration records with newer execution timestamp/name identities while the repository contains over 400 historical SQL files.
Current plan grants are correct but underlying Office RLS is not, and these are separate truth dimensions.
Current private read helper absent; service-role Office RPC may exist but cannot be read by a browser.
One of the three tables lacks an expected column even if it has row level security switched on.
An otherwise complete metadata snapshot uses a stale timestamp, wrong target or missing catalog arrays.

alternatives.summary: Add exact read-only database topology and plan-authority preflight to the existing Office readiness check with fail-closed tests; deploy nothing.
alternatives.reason: Safely identifies the dependency chain and preserves live canonical authority for a later independently gated schema release.

alternatives.summary: Immediately apply all five missing historical Office migrations in filename order.
alternatives.reason: One historical migration replaces the working normalized plan sync with stale fixed arrays; the staging schema lacks prerequisite privacy objects.

alternatives.summary: Treat currently green Next.js UI/route gates as sufficient and waive database Pro-only evidence.
alternatives.reason: Service-role/RPC and authenticated RLS exposure remain unproven and must fail closed.

specialistReviews.finding: The existing readiness script is the canonical U09 schema evidence boundary.
specialistReviews.resolution: Extend the same script and tests; do not create a second release or entitlement engine.

specialistReviews.finding: A catalog-only script cannot prove RLS semantics or the confidentiality of SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep metadata result non-authoritative; explicitly require authenticated role, tenant transition and service-role RPC behavioral proof.

specialistReviews.finding: Staging retains Block 11 normalized plan grants and plan sync even though historical Office migration versions are absent.
specialistReviews.resolution: Flag plan-sync authority and schema prerequisites; do not apply historical plan-sync blindly or mutate actual subscriptions.

challenge.scenario: The five missing migration files are applied directly.
challenge.finding: One redefines canonical tenant plan sync and may remove or reactivate granted capabilities.
challenge.resolution: Use read-only report and a later dependency-ordered adapted SQL release; never replay the obsolete sync.

challenge.scenario: RLS is enabled but three old ALL policies still permit ordinary support reads.
challenge.finding: A positive RLS enabled flag is misleading because the qual remains legacy.
challenge.resolution: Keep broad policy and Pro predicate blockers mandatory.

challenge.scenario: Privacy participant table or conversation_type does not exist.
challenge.finding: A new thread-read policy may call absent objects and make the inbox inaccessible.
challenge.resolution: Preflight both underlying objects and stop before any schema deployment.

challenge.scenario: A deployment had timestamp-renamed migration identity.
challenge.finding: Version-based registry comparison can produce false positives or false negatives.
challenge.resolution: Capture execution lineage separately; never infer deployed source from a filename alone.

challenge.scenario: A catalog has plausible restrictive policy SQL but public RPC bypasses it.
challenge.finding: Claiming authoritative completion from catalog overstates security.
challenge.resolution: Retain REVIEW and require service-role/RPC and authenticated actor behavior proof.

challenge.scenario: Updating Office schema would disrupt Alap emails or current Block 11 plan grants.
challenge.finding: A security fix can become an entitlement regression.
challenge.resolution: U11A only collects metadata and protects the approved Alap/Pro model for later migration design.

proofPlan: Read exact main and post-merge green CI before plan creation; collect credential-free staging-only catalog facts with the Supabase read-only SQL tool.
Confirm Development Guard known-failure scope and Plan Before Code PASS before editing script/tests.
Implement only additive snapshot fields and fail-closed readiness checks; preserve old error codes and REVIEW semantics.
Add negative tests for missing participant table, conversation type column, private current-user helper and incorrect plan-sync basis.
Run Edit-Time, Knowledge Preflight, Incremental Replay, full CI and exact-head Completion Truth/Lifecycle.
After U11A merge, prepare a separate staged SQL migration/rehearsal U11B, excluding obsolete entitlement sync, with explicit rollback and behavioral proof.

requirements.requirement: Canonical Office DB readiness fail-closes on missing schema/privacy requirements and preserves Block 11 plan-authority while withholding all runtime completion claims.

claimScope.breadth: staging Office read-only schema and migration preflight

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No metadata-only result or obsolete migration may mark Office RLS capability DONE or authorize plan sync overwrite.

notes: U11A is a bounded data-security readiness prerequisite, not a DB rollout. Main observed at 00821465577ac0e586b08bf2d94b34e08d0f9fca, successful post-merge CI 38215283132 and Factory 38215283118. Staging has 113 migration history records, historical Office migrations absent, 3 legacy authenticated ALL policies, absent participant table, conversation_type and current-user read helper. Crucially existing private.sync_webshop_plan_entitlements uses normalized plan_capability_grants and the Alap/Pro grant matrix is aligned with accepted PO scope. Do not apply historical sync files. #1186 remains OPEN.
